name: Mermaid
description: Renders a Mermaid diagram with a concise accessible name, prose summary, and visible structured text alternative.

title.description: Concise meaningful name for the diagram

description.description: Short prose summary of the diagram purpose and relationships

accessibleDetails.description: Structured or prose equivalent of every material relationship in the diagram

detailsLabel.description: Label for the visible text-alternative disclosure

themeColors.description: Diagram color overrides: CSS colours or var(--token) references. Defaults to --color-text and --color-border, so diagrams follow the theme.
